description: This file defines utility functions for formatting currency amounts, including a wrapper for a utility function 'formatCurrencyAmount' that formats currency with optional decimal precision.

methods.name: formatCurrency
methods.description: A wrapper around 'formatCurrencyAmount' for formatting currency values with a specified currency (default 'USD').

methods.name: formatUsdUpTo8
methods.description: Formats a number as USD with up to 8 decimal places, trimming trailing zeros.
